contract: Original nearly_integral and SkAnalyticEdge::setLine compiled unchanged. Adapter applies the all-four BW shortcut and determines whether native snapped rectangle boundaries leave a fractional edge within an integer bitmap. This is numerical classification evidence; it does not execute full SkRasterClip/SkAAClip mask construction, successive clip intersections, clipping cache transitions or rendering. Independent browser controls additionally adjudicate opaque-tile and AA dispatch behavior.
